subject: Moons of the solar system and the funny, dramatic ways a cartoon astronaut in a spacesuit could die on them.

variants.prompt: Exception to the layout rule: two large cartoon astronaut heads in helmets side by side, filling the whole frame edge to edge on a dark starry background, like a before/after comparison. Left head: face glowing sickly neon green, dizzy eyes, a huge banded Jupiter reflected in the visor (radiation on Io). Right head: face frozen solid and pale blue, visor cracked and covered in frost and icicles (extreme cold on Triton). Leave a strip of plain dark space above each head for a label.

Exception to the layout rule: two large cartoon astronaut heads in helmets side by side, filling the whole frame edge to edge on a dark starry background. Left head: screaming, being blasted upward by a white icy geyser jet, ice crystals all around (Enceladus). Right head: face glowing sickly neon green with radiation, dizzy eyes, a huge banded Jupiter reflected in the visor (Io). Leave a strip of plain dark space above each head for a label.

The astronaut tumbling off the edge of an impossibly tall grey ice cliff on a small pale moon, arms and legs flailing, shocked face, a pale blue ringed Uranus in the black sky, huge empty drop below him so the fall looks endless.

The astronaut falling calmly beside an impossibly tall grey ice cliff on a small pale moon, bored expression, checking a wristwatch mid-fall, a pale blue ringed Uranus in the black sky, the bottom of the cliff far below and out of sight.

The astronaut WITHOUT a spacesuit, wearing only an oxygen mask, a puffy red winter coat and homemade feathered bird wings strapped to his arms, flying joyfully through thick orange haze over a dark methane lake on Titan, huge ringed Saturn faint in the sky, Arka (gold spacesuit) flying beside him with wings too.

Arka, the gold-suited mascot, standing triumphantly with homemade bird wings on an orange hazy moon (Titan) with Saturn in the sky, while behind him in the dark sky a row of six small grey moons each has a big red X over it.
